[[Staff of Ruin]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Consort of Ruin]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Depths of Madness]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Communing]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +60

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Pyric Staff]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Communing]] [[staves]]:
**[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[Communing]] [[staves]]:
**[[Communing Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*The [[Communing]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Alsin's Walking Stick]] and [[Ritualistic Shadow Staff]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Lightning damage]] and require [[Spawning Power]].
*[[Kerrsh's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
